item.title: BTS’ ‘NORMAL’ Music Video Sets Spotify Single-Day Streaming Record
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music news. Today, we're talking about the phenomenon that is BTS. The K-pop sensations have just set a new record on Spotify, and we're here to give you the details."
[Short music transition]
Host: "According to Spotify, BTS' new music video 'NORMAL' has become the most-streamed K-pop music video in a single day in the platform's history. The video, directed by Ukrainian filmmaker Tanu Muino, offers a unique glimpse into the group's life beyond the spotlight, showcasing members Jin, Suga, J-Hope, RM, Jimin, V, and Jung Kook unwinding together in an ornate mansion."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The 'NORMAL' music video is available exclusively on Spotify for the first 48 hours, and Premium subscribers can watch it on their TV, desktop, or mobile device. The song is part of BTS' fifth studio album, ARIRANG, which has already broken records as the most-streamed K-pop album in Spotify history."
[Short music transition]
Host: "BTS is on a roll, with their previous single 'SWIM' debuting at number one on the Billboard Hot 100, and ARIRANG opening at number one on the Billboard 200. And if you're a fan, you can catch them on their world tour, which continues with a two-night run in France, followed by a co-headlining performance at the inaugural FIFA World Cup Final Halftime Show alongside Justin Bieber, Madonna, and Shakira."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode!"
